federal_summary: CMS guidance dated November 13, 2026 offers states an optional hold-harmless period through June 30, 2027. A participating state must still assess whether applicable people meet the requirement or qualify for an exclusion or exception; the state may suspend denials and disenrollments based solely on community-engagement noncompliance during its approved period.

states.summary: No state-specific hold-harmless election has been verified in this preview. The federal January 1, 2027 date remains the baseline unless the state adopts an approved hold-harmless period or another approved implementation option.
